fields.name: Users
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x1B1BF00 (~ProcessBlockEvents): clears the view's component at +0x20 when its key count (+0x2C) is non-zero (FUN_1405DA5B0), then for an unblock event calls FUN_1405DA760 (get-or-insert) and assigns the event's STDString (BlockedUser +0x10) to the returned value. FUN_1405DA760 -> FUN_1405CA360: key hash = qword0 ^ qword1 (16-byte key, Guid hash); values array at +0x30 with stride 0x18, new value initialised as an empty STDString. Same function handles TrackingBlockedUsers (view +0x70) identically. Game default constructor bg3.exe+0x1B1EBA0 zeroes 64 bytes. Live: all zero.

open_questions: The value string's meaning (user name / platform id) is not read anywhere seen
second_pass: HashMap<Guid, STDString> confirmed on Windows: bg3.exe+0x1B1BF00 inserts through FUN_1405DA760/FUN_1405CA360 (16-byte key hashed as two qwords, 0x18-byte STDString values at +0x30).
live_reason: only empty (all-zero) instances were seen: the member boundaries are untested
